steps.en: Results are shown on screen to the officer
steps.id: Hasil ditampilkan di layar untuk officer
steps.why_en: The screen shows a different report, not ownership enquiry results.
steps.why_id: Layar menampilkan report lain, bukan hasil enquiry kepemilikan.

steps.en: Notice number, offence date and time, car park, vehicle and amount are shown
steps.id: Nomor notice, tanggal dan jam offence, car park, kendaraan dan jumlah ditampilkan
steps.why_en: The columns belong to a different report, not the ownership result.
steps.why_id: Kolom milik report lain, bukan hasil kepemilikan.

steps.en: The result flags a change in vehicle ownership
steps.why_en: The result has no ownership-change flag.
steps.why_id: Hasil tidak punya penanda perubahan kepemilikan.

steps.en: The result flags a deregistered vehicle
steps.id: Hasil menandai kendaraan yang sudah deregistered
steps.why_en: The RIP result has no deregistered flag; only a separate LTA report shows it.
steps.why_id: Hasil RIP tidak punya penanda deregistered; hanya report LTA terpisah.
